genius.notes: EURI is MiCA-authorized under Banking Circle S.A.'s Luxembourg credit-institution authorization. That EU authorization does not establish U.S. GENIUS approval. The current OCC digital-assets applications table and scoped regulator searches did not identify an EURI/Banking Circle PPSI approval, official GENIUS application, state qualification or registered foreign-issuer exception as of 2026-10-07. The OCC table is a pending digital-assets licensing inventory, not an exhaustive GENIUS register. Issuer disclosures document 1:1 EUR reserves and par redemption; no public monthly reserve-attestation series was located. The expected Act effective date remains 2027-01-18; the broader DASP issuer restriction has a separate 2028-07-18 date. The 2026-09-30 state-committee procedural interim rule does not qualify an issuer. The negative finding is limited to the public sources and searches reviewed, not confidential filings or proceedings. The reopened EURI fiduciary terms prohibit offers or sales in the United States or to, for the account of, or for the benefit of U.S. persons as defined under Securities Act regulations. This is an issuer distribution restriction, not a GENIUS approval or foreign-exception decision. Banking Circle GENIUS commentary published 1 July and 7 August 2026 and its 15 September OSL partnership announcement discuss general regulation and payment infrastructure without announcing an EURI PPSI application or foreign registration.
